text:
{
  "strengths": [
    "Strong interpersonal and social communication skills with peers and teachers",
    "Proficient in practical vocational tasks including component assembly and material sorting",
    "Demonstrates strong motivation, work ethic, and focus during hands-on activities"
  ],
  "challenges": [
    "Difficulty comprehending complex abstract texts and multi-step written instructions",
    "Limitations in advanced mathematical reasoning and generalized arithmetic application",
    "Requires structured support for transition planning and independent vocational task execution"
  ],
  "learning_style": "Kinesthetic and visual learner, benefiting greatly from hands-on demonstration, task analysis, and repetitive practice.",
  "recommended_supports": [
    "Task-analyzed step-by-step visual checklists for vocational and daily living activities",
    "Modified functional academic curriculum focusing on practical literacy and numeracy",
    "Job coaching and supported employment readiness training with regular feedback"
  ],
  "short_term_goals": [
    "By end of Term 1, student will independently complete a 5-step assembly task as measured by vocational workshop observational checklists and time logs",
    "By end of Term 2, student will accurately calculate correct change for transactions up to 500 INR as measured by functional math practical assessment rubrics"
  ],
  "long_term_goals": [
    "By end of academic year, student will successfully complete a two-week external vocational internship demonstrating workplace safety and punctuality as measured by employer evaluation sheets and job coach logs"
  ],
  "academic_performance": {
    "overall_level": "below_grade",
    "strong_subjects": [
      "Vocational Training",
      "Practical Workshops"
    ],
    "weak_subjects": [
      "Advanced Mathematics",
      "Abstract Literature"
    ],
    "grade_trajectory": "stable"
  },
  "behavioural_notes": [
    "Highly motivated and cooperative during practical and vocational sessions",
    "Responds well to positive reinforcement and structured routine environments"
  ],
  "assistive_tech_needs": [
    "Visual schedule boards and step-by-step pictorial task guides"
  ]
}
